newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two boys killed and sexually mutilated in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Two boys killed and sexually mutilated in Brazil.

text.p: Brazilian police are hunting for a serial killer after finding two boys, aged 10 and 11, dead with their sexual organs mutilated in northeastern Maranhao state, a police spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
She said police found on Monday the bodies of the two boys with the sexual organs cut off in a wooded area in Paco do Lumiar, 15 miles (24 km) from the state capital of Sao Luis.
Both boys had been raped and one had his neck broken, but the exact cause of their death had not been established yet, the spokeswoman said.

"We believe the boys may have been the victims of the same person who killed another three boys in Paco do Lumiar in the last three years," she said. "The other three were also sexually mutilated and their bodies were also found in wooded areas."
The bodies of another two boys were found with similar mutilations last year on the outskirts of Sao Luis, she added.
Police have arrested three men who were allegedly seen with the boys, reported missing since Saturday.
